name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefit: ₹2 lakh accidental death/disability cover at just ₹20/year (less than ₹2/month)
benefit_hindi: Sirf ₹20 saalana mein ₹2 lakh ka durghatna bima

eligibility.description: Any Indian citizen aged 18-70 years with a bank account
eligibility.description_hindi: 18-70 saal ka koi bhi Bharatiya naagrik jiske paas bank account ho

steps: In case of accident, nominee contacts bank for claim
steps_hindi: Apne bank ki branch mein jaayein
Premium bank account se kat jaayega
Durghatna hone par nominee bank se claim kare

hindi_summary: PM Suraksha Bima mein sirf 20 rupaye saalana mein 2 lakh rupaye ka durghatna bima milta hai. Bank jaayein aur form bharein. Ye sabse sasta bima hai — mahine ka 2 rupaye se bhi kam!
